This ensures that each transaction has an identifier throughout its lifecycle, allowing the database engine to track concurrent modifications, detect conflicts, and maintain consistency across distributed systems.

- Access Methods (B-trees, GIN trees etc.)
- Transaction Manager (`src/backend/utils`)

- **XIDs:** Each active transaction gets assigned a globally unique identifier called "XID." These IDs increment monotonically based on internal counters stored persistently during recovery scenarios.
